국가연구소 NRL 2.0 연구를 통해 로봇의 몸이 환경에 적응하고 연산을: Through the NRL 2.0 National Research Laboratory program, we study embodied physical intelligence, in which a robot’s body adapts to its environment and shares the computational workload, alongside distributed intelligence built on cooperating functional modules. Three human-centered application areas and four shared technical cores come together to develop efficient, trustworthy physical AI robotics.
세 가지 적용 분야를 네 가지 공통 원천기술로 연결합니다. 하드웨어와 지: Four shared technical cores connect three application areas, spanning the design of hardware and intelligence, validation in real environments, and standards that earn public trust.
몸에서 시작하는 물리 지능: Physical Intelligence Begins with the Body
연성 소재와 구조의 변형을 활용해 로봇의 몸이 환경에 적응하고, 접촉과: We use soft materials and structural deformation to help robot bodies adapt to their surroundings and share computation through contact and movement.
로봇 부위별 지능이 학습과 경험을 나누고, 전체 시스템이 맥락에 맞게 협: We study how intelligent modules share learning and experience, cooperate in context, and adapt as a system to changing environments.
로봇·사람·환경의 디지털 트윈: Digital Twins of Robots, People and Environments
로봇과 사람, 주변 환경의 상호작용을 가상 공간에 반영해 설계와 학습,: Virtual models capture interactions between robots, people and their surroundings to accelerate design, learning and validation alongside physical experiments.
안전성·임상적 신뢰성·사용자 수용성을 살피고, 데이터 윤리와 사회적 기준: We study safety, clinical reliability and user acceptance together with data ethics and societal standards.
가정과 생활 공간의 변화, 사용자의 의도와 필요에 적응하며 일상 과제를: We develop robots that adapt to changes in homes and living spaces, understand users’ intentions and needs, and help with everyday tasks.
사용자의 움직임과 개인 특성을 고려해 힘과 균형, 다양한 신체 활동을 자: We explore wearable robots that naturally support strength, balance and physical activity while adapting to each person’s movement and characteristics.
좁고 민감한 체내 환경과 조화를 이루며 작동하는 소형 로봇 기술과 의료: We investigate miniature robotic technologies that work in harmony with confined, sensitive environments inside the body, and explore their medical applications.
연구소의 비전과 운영 방향을 세우고, 연구·운영 조직이 함께 움직이도록: Our leadership sets the Institute’s vision and direction, aligning research and operations.

advance four shared technical cores together.
프로젝트 그룹(PG)은 로봇이 사람과 만나는 적용 현장을 정의합니다. 기: Project groups (PGs) define the application settings where robots meet people. Technical cores (TCs) develop the bodies, intelligence, validation frameworks and societal trust these applications require. Three PGs and four TCs form an integrated structure that connects every stage of research.
모든 프로젝트 그룹은 네 기술 코어와 협력합니다. 아래 표는 개별 과제의: Every project group collaborates with all four technical cores. The table illustrates the overall research architecture rather than a fixed assignment of individual projects.
PG는 사람 중심의 응용 문제를 제시하고, TC는 하드웨어부터 지능·검증: PGs frame human-centered application challenges. TCs provide shared foundations spanning hardware, intelligence, validation and human value. Each intersection summarizes how a technical core contributes to a project group.
사람과 만나는 세 연구 현장: Three Settings Where Robots Meet People
로봇이 실제로 작동할 환경과 사람의 필요를 중심에 두고, 서로 다른 크기: We address challenges at different scales and under different conditions, guided by human needs and the environments where robots will operate.
가정과 생활 공간처럼 구조가 고정되지 않은 열린 환경에서 사람의 의도와: We study robots that understand human intentions and environmental changes, and share everyday tasks in open, unstructured settings such as homes and living spaces.
사람과 공간의 변화에 대응하는 적응형 몸과 움직임: Adaptive bodies and movement that respond to changes in people and spaces
상황과 사용자의 필요를 반영하는 지능·상호작용: Intelligence and interaction informed by context and user needs
실제 생활 환경에서 반복적으로 학습하고 검증하는 방법: Methods for iterative learning and validation in real living environments
사람의 움직임을 확장하는 웨어러블 로봇: Wearable Robots that Extend Human Movement
사람의 신체와 직접 맞닿는 로봇으로 움직임과 힘, 균형을 보조하고 개인의: Robots worn directly on the body support movement, strength and balance, providing a natural experience tailored to each person’s physical characteristics.
신체 움직임과 사용자의 의도를 반영하는 보조 기술: Assistive technologies that respond to body movement and user intent
착용감·구동 성능을 함께 고려하는 개인 맞춤형 설계: Personalized designs that balance comfort and actuation performance
사람과 로봇의 상호작용 데이터를 활용한 설계·평가: Design and evaluation informed by human–robot interaction data
인체 내부에서 작동하는 로봇: Robots that Operate Inside the Human Body
좁고 민감한 체내 환경에서 주변 조직과 조화를 이루며 작동하는 로봇과 인: We develop robots and interfaces that operate in harmony with surrounding tissue in confined, sensitive internal environments, and build validation frameworks connected to clinical practice.
협소하고 복잡한 환경에 대응하는 유연·적응형 구조: Soft, adaptive structures for confined and complex environments
생체 환경과 로봇의 상호작용을 고려한 정밀 동작: Precise motion that accounts for interactions between robots and biological environments
안전성과 임상적 신뢰를 갖춘 실증·평가 방법: Demonstration and evaluation methods grounded in safety and clinical reliability
응용의 질문에서 원천기술로,: From application challenges to foundational technologies,
원천기술에서 현실의 로봇으로: from foundational technologies to real-world robots
세 PG가 필요한 문제와 검증 조건을 제시하면, 네 TC가 함께 기술 해: The three PGs define challenges and validation requirements, and the four TCs develop technical solutions together. Applying the results back in each setting strengthens the connection between research and practice.
세 연구그룹을 잇는 네 기술 코어: Four Technical Cores Connecting Three Project Groups
몸과 지능을 함께 설계하고, 현실을 정밀하게 시험하며, 사람과 사회가 신: We co-design bodies and intelligence, test real-world conditions precisely, and develop technologies that people and society can trust.
로봇의 소재와 구조가 환경에 따라 변형되고 접촉·마찰·움직임을 활용해 계: We study embodied physical intelligence: materials and structures adapt to the environment and share computation through contact, friction and movement.
강성·형태를 조절하는 적응형 소재와 구조: Adaptive materials and structures with tunable stiffness and shape
촉각·접촉을 활용하는 감지 및 물리 연산: Sensing and physical computation through touch and contact
세 PG가 활용할 수 있는 모듈형 로봇 하드웨어: Modular robotic hardware shared across all three PGs
로봇의 각 부위와 기능에 분산된 지능 모듈이 국소적으로 학습하고 경험을: Intelligent modules distributed across a robot’s parts and functions learn locally, share experience, and cooperate in context at the system level.
로봇의 기능과 부위에 맞춘 분산형 학습 모듈: Distributed learning modules tailored to robot functions and components
전역 맥락에 따라 모듈을 조정하는 협력 구조: Cooperative architectures that coordinate modules using global context
변화하는 환경에서의 지속 학습과 효율적 적응: Continual learning and efficient adaptation in changing environments
사람과 로봇, 환경이 상호작용하는 조건을 가상 공간에 반영해 설계와 학습: We model interactions among people, robots and environments in virtual space to accelerate design, learning and testing, while grounding these models in physical experiments.
로봇·인체·환경의 물리적 상호작용 모델링: Modeling physical interactions among robots, the human body and environments
가상·실제 데이터를 연결하는 데이터 기반: Data foundations connecting virtual and physical observations
실험 설계와 성능·안전성 검증의 반복 가속: Faster iteration in experiment design and performance and safety validation
사람과 사회가 신뢰하는 로봇: Robots that People and Society Can Trust
성능을 넘어 안전, 자율성, 임상적 신뢰성, 사회적 수용성을 연구 설계에: Beyond performance, we incorporate safety, autonomy, clinical reliability and societal acceptance into research design. We assess technological impacts and develop standards for responsible use.
개발 초기부터 사람을 고려하는 가치 설계: Value-sensitive design that considers people from the outset
위험 요소를 점검하는 스트레스 테스트와 검증: Stress testing and validation to identify risks
안전·윤리·수용성에 대한 평가 기준과 신뢰 기반: Evaluation criteria and foundations for trust in safety, ethics and acceptance
로봇은 정해진 환경에서 주어진 일을 수행하는 기계를 넘어, 사람과 환경의: Robots are evolving beyond machines that perform predefined tasks in fixed settings. They are becoming technologies that respond to changes in people and their surroundings and move alongside us in the physical world. Our Institute pursues a new approach to physical AI through the co-design of robot bodies and intelligence.
몸의 형태와 소재가 환경에 적응하며 물리적 계산을 나누는 체화된 지능,: We will expand the possibilities of robots that operate efficiently and safely in the real world, combining embodied intelligence, in which morphology and materials adapt and share physical computation, with distributed intelligence, in which functional modules learn and cooperate.
이 연구를 일상생활을 돕는 동반 로봇, 사람의 움직임을 보조하고 확장하는: We aim to translate this research into companion robots for daily life, wearable robots that support and extend human movement, and robotic technologies that operate inside the body. Technology can improve people’s lives when researchers across engineering, AI, medicine, life sciences and other disciplines ask questions and experiment together.
기술의 성능만큼 안전과 신뢰, 사회적 수용성을 중요하게 생각합니다. 연구: We value safety, trust and societal acceptance as much as technical performance. We will build an environment where researchers and students can pursue bold questions without fear of failure, and work to turn research outcomes into new possibilities for education, industry and society.
We invite you to join SNU Robotics Institute on this journey. Thank you.

서울대학교 로보틱스연구소는 여러 분야의 연구자와 연구실이 로보틱스의 난제: The SNU Robotics Institute brings researchers and laboratories together across disciplines to address the challenges of robotics. We study robots that serve people in care, everyday life, manufacturing and medicine, considering safety, trust, dignity and social acceptance alongside technical performance.
몸의 지능과 모듈의 협력을 함께: Intelligence in the body. Cooperation across modules.
로봇이 복잡한 현실에서 유연하게 움직이려면 몸의 구조와 재료, 감각과 제: For robots to act flexibly in the real world, body structure, materials, sensing and control must work together. We investigate embodied physical intelligence arising from interactions between the body and its surroundings, alongside distributed intelligence through cooperation among functional modules. Our aim goes beyond reproducing human form to explore forms and functions that meet human needs.
네 가지 기술 코어 × 세 가지 프로젝트 그룹: Four Technical Cores × Three Project Groups
MORPHI, MOSAIC, 디지털 트윈, Human Value의 네 기: Four Technical Cores—MORPHI, MOSAIC, Digital Twin and Human Value—advance shared foundations and approaches to validation. Three Project Groups focus on Life Companion, Wearable and Intra-body robotics, beginning with human needs and practical challenges. Collaboration across TCs and PGs connects foundational technology with application-driven research.
전공의 경계를 넘어 함께 연구합니다: A community that works across disciplines
참여교수와 연계교수는 공학·인공지능·의학·생명과학 등 다양한 전문성을 연: Participating and affiliated faculty connect expertise across engineering, AI, medicine, life sciences and other fields. Researchers can contribute to multiple TCs and PGs, sharing questions and experience while building collaboration across laboratories.
논문에서 현장으로, 기술에서 삶으로: From research to the real world
연구의 결과가 논문에 머물지 않도록 교육, 실제 환경에서의 검증, 산학협: We work to carry research beyond papers into education, testing in real settings, industry collaboration and technology transfer. We aim to create an environment where students and early-career researchers learn by building and testing, and where researchers and partners explore what robotics can achieve in practice.
